cards.answer: Twisted Fate is a mage and marksman whose magic damage benefits from AD and AP. He combines empowered card attacks and a stun with piercing card throws, while his ultimate reveals enemies and enables a channeled teleport.
cards.counterplay: Respect his stun threat, sidestep his card throws, and retreat toward support when he threatens to teleport.

cards.counterplay: Pressure his farming when safe to limit his bonus income.

cards.answer: Pick a Card lets Twisted Fate select a card to empower his next basic attack with magic damage. Blue Card deals increased damage and restores mana; Red Card damages and slows the target and surrounding enemies; Gold Card stuns the target.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from his attack range when he threatens Gold Card, and spread out against Red Card.

cards.answer: Stacked Deck passively grants attack speed. His basic attacks build stacks; at maximum stacks, his next basic attack consumes them to deal bonus magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended attack trades and respect his empowered attack after he has been attacking.

cards.answer: Destiny reveals enemy champions and enables Gate. Gate channels before teleporting Twisted Fate to a target location within range, destroying enemy projectiles targeting him as he teleports. Immobilizing or cast-inhibiting effects can interrupt the channel.
cards.counterplay: Move toward support when revealed, and use suitable crowd control to interrupt his channel when possible.
